title: Former maquila employees protest over unpaid benefits at Zip Buena Vista
reason: The opened report explicitly identifies the demand as payment of employment benefits owed by the private employer; no demand to the Honduran State or state policy is documented.
notes: The report’s “more than a thousand employees waiting for payment” is not a count of people simultaneously at the protest. This is preserved as a private labor dispute rather than treated as an eligible state-target event.
